global_coordinate_system: UTM Zone 16N, WGS84, ground returns only (canopy filtered)

registration.method: Overlap 30-50% between flight lines, ICP on ground DEM, GPS/IMU for initial alignment
registration.vegetation_filter: First returns = canopy (removed), last returns = ground (kept). Object-based vegetation classification per Inomata et al. 2018 Ceibal method
registration.dem_generation: Ground points -> TIN -> 1m DEM, then hillshade visualization reveals pyramids

scenes.label: Entire landscape 2,100km2, 61,000 structures, interconnected network of dozens of cities
scenes.provenance: Each ground point retains flight ID and return number (first/last)
